prompt:
Generate a production 4 by 3 sprite sheet (1536x1024 landscape) of TWELVE independent NATURAL TERRAIN MOUNDS for a hand-painted detailed isometric dark fantasy RPG. True transparent background, no text, no grid. Ground axes 2 horizontal to 1 vertical. Upper-left light. Dark charcoal basalt and dusty warm gray ash, subtle burnt reddish soil. Each cell has generous clear margins. The landscape must look like gradual natural hills and mounds, NOT fences or walls.
CRITICAL: NO long narrow ridges, NO rows of upright stones, NO uniform vertical rock faces, NO sharp straight crests, NO architecture. All forms are BROAD sloping heaps, rounded asymmetrical ash dunes with occasional boulders half buried in them. Width roughly three times height. Painted edges feather naturally into the ground with transparent ash speckles. Occupy 80 percent of each cell width, base center about 78 percent cell height. High quality detailed brushwork.
Row1 four variations of broad low ash-and-basalt scree hills, first and third longer along screen upper-left/lower-right, second and fourth along upper-right/lower-left. Smooth irregular rising slopes, no retaining wall, rocky lumps softly emerge from heaps.
Row2 four irregular wide mound ends and rounded hill turns, varying shape, each standalone connected natural slope.
Row3 first and second broad sloping dark basalt rubble with a single tiny ember crevice, third flat feather-edged ash-and-pebble ground diamond with a very soft perimeter, fourth a natural compact cluster of 3-5 large weathered boulders HALF BURIED in a broad low ash mound.
True alpha transparency between objects and outside edges. No smoke, no gray background, no scenic image.
